headline: German business confidence rises again
summary: The Ifo business climate index rose for a seventh consecutive month, reaching 90.6 points. The gain points to improving sentiment among German firms.
why: The Ifo index, published by the Munich-based Ifo Institute, is a closely watched survey of German business expectations and a leading indicator for Europe's largest economy.
